title: Invertibility of the ordinary exceptional right mate by reference transport
statement: Fix P,X0,c0,S and the normalized left-realization data A of [lem-sf-exceptional-realization-left-models]. For every native functor J with the supplied adjunction F_native ⊣ J, the ordinary natural transformation Adjunction.forgetfulRightMate adj O.adjunction A.left is invertible [lem-sf-forgetful-representing-pair-right-mate], where O is the supplied coefficient exceptional adjunction. This asserts invertibility of the fixed ordinary mate only, without a Frobenius equation or a point-unit specialization.

proof.text: In the reference package, transpose its counit equation. The injectivity of the coefficient adjunction Hom equivalence identifies its right isomorphism with the fixed forgetfulRightMate of its left isomorphism, so this reference right mate is invertible.

proof.text: The mate b of A.functorComparison is invertible because its two coefficient-change functors are equivalences. For each L, transpose EX(gamma_L) b_(VY L) through the reference adjunction. Naturality of the coefficient comparison and the counit formula give c_(VX J L) EY(a_(J L)^-1) EY(VY(epsilon_native,L)). Insert y at F_native J L and apply left_reference; naturality of y cancels its inverse. The reference counit formula then gives the transpose of x_(J L) gamma_reference,L G_reference(y_L^-1). Injectivity proves equality of these arrows. The latter composite is invertible; cancel b and reflect isomorphisms through EX. This is the complete private right_mate_isIso_of_reference proof in Lean.

theorem exceptional_realization_right_mate_isIso
    (A : ExceptionalRealizationLeftData P X₀ c₀ S)
    (J : WeilComplex P.field.k₀ P.coefficients.l (Spec (.of P.field.k₀)) ⥤
      WeilComplex P.field.k₀ P.coefficients.l X₀.left)
    (adj : WeilComplex.derivedLowerShriek P.field.k₀ P.coefficients.l X₀.hom ⊣ J) :
    IsIso (Adjunction.forgetfulRightMate adj
      (operation P.field P.coefficients.l P.coefficients.different
        P.coefficients.Qbar X₀ (point P.field) (pointMap P.field X₀) c₀ S .closed).adjunction
      A.left)
